components.name: typed joint-coupling liveness gates
components.project_addition: Determines when a joint witness coupling can be demoted to one-dimensional marginals under declared semantics. MAY uses a cylinder-forcing/full-projection gate; exact COUNT uses additive one-coordinate potentials and is a recursive Structural Target instance on the count tensor; LABEL-SET decomposes labelwise into Boolean MAY gates. Full joint COUNT relative to one-way marginals has free p-adic defect rank product(n_i)-sum(n_i)+(m-1). Generic monoids fall back to recursive P023 compilation of coupling-certificate state.
